$comment: Bundle budgets (docs/02 §9, O-15, O-26), checked by scripts/bundle-budget.mjs on production builds made with `vite build --manifest`. KB = 1024 bytes of gzip (level 9). `roots` are Vite manifest keys whose chunks, CSS and static imports load before the screen paints: the HTML entry, the route's chunk, and any module the app awaits at start-up with a top-level `await import(...)` (attendee src/data/backend.ts, admin src/live/backend.ts). Dynamic imports that are not awaited at start-up (the API client `remote`, lazy routes) and fonts are not counted. `enforce` lists the build modes in which a breach fails the check; other modes are reported only.
